from primitive_api import get_task_context, list_actions, observe, inspect_current_view, query_inventory, check_progress_public, write_evidence

ctx = get_task_context()
obs = observe()
view = inspect_current_view(label="start", remember=True)
inv = query_inventory()
prog = check_progress_public()
acts = list_actions()

print("CONTEXT:", ctx)
print("OBSERVE:", obs)
print("VIEW SUMMARY:", {k: view.get(k) for k in ("saved","path","shape","remembered_count","memory_count")})
print("VISIBLE:", view.get("visible_objects"))
print("INVENTORY:", inv)
print("PROGRESS:", prog)
print("ACTIONS:", acts)

write_evidence("start", {"context": ctx, "observe": obs, "visible": view.get("visible_objects"), "inventory": inv, "progress": prog})

steps.code:
from primitive_api import rotate, look, move_ahead, inspect_current_view, detect_objects, write_evidence

# Face the desk (desk is to agent's right side per frame). Turn right ~90deg then tilt down.
rotate("right"); rotate("right")
look("down")
v = inspect_current_view(label="face_desk", remember=True)
print("POSE_VIEW:", [(o["objectType"], round(o["distance"],2)) for o in v.get("visible_objects", [])])

# Approach the desk
desk = None
for o in v.get("visible_objects", []):
    if o["objectType"] == "Desk":
        desk = o
print("DESK:", desk)
if desk:
    from primitive_api import approach_object
    ap = approach_object(desk, max_steps=4, stop_distance=1.0)
    print("APPROACH:", ap.get("final_distance"), ap.get("events"))

v2 = inspect_current_view(label="at_desk", remember=True)
print("AT_DESK:", [(o["objectType"], o["objectId"], round(o["distance"],2)) for o in v2.get("visible_objects", [])])
write_evidence("desk_state", {"desk": desk, "at_desk": v2.get("visible_objects")})
</br>
